request.style: English, anthemic Christian rock, strong gritty male vocal, distorted electric guitars, driving bass, big drums, gang vocals on the chorus, bold and determined, 128 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The old man sleeps in Moab and the forty years are through
The servant of the LORD is gone, the people look to you
The Jordan's rolling wide ahead, the far bank out of sight
And Joshua son of Nun stands listening at the river's side

[Pre-Chorus]
Moses my servant is dead
Now get up and cross this Jordan
As I was with Moses, so I will be with you
I will not fail you or forsake you

[Chorus]
Have I not commanded you
Be strong and courageous
Do not be terrified or dismayed
For the LORD your God is with you wherever you go

[Verse]
Keep the law upon your lips and think on it by day and night
Never turning from the road to the left hand or the right
When the walls ahead are high and your knees begin to shake
Remember who has spoken and the promise he won't break

[Pre-Chorus]
Moses my servant is dead
Now get up and cross this Jordan
As I was with Moses, so I will be with you
I will not fail you or forsake you

[Chorus]
Have I not commanded you
Be strong and courageous
Do not be terrified or dismayed
For the LORD your God is with you wherever you go

[Bridge]
Every place where the sole of your foot treads I have given you
No one will be able to stand against you
Be strong and very courageous
Be strong and very courageous

[Outro]
The LORD your God is with you wherever you go
